children: XPLR Infrastructure reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $332 million, up 5.4% from $315 million a year earlier. Net income attributable to XPLR was $51 million, compared with a $37 million loss, and diluted EPS was $0.54 versus a loss of $0.4 per share.
¹ Reported as “Operating Revenues (A)”. ² Reported as “Net Income (Loss) Attributable To Xplr”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
For the first nine months of 2026, operating revenues rose 3% to $971 million from $939 million a year earlier.
XPLR advanced four battery-storage projects, two of which entered joint ventures; completion is expected in 2027.
Wind repowering continued and accounted for most capital-project spending. Management expects planned projects to qualify for clean-energy tax credits.
Third-quarter operations and maintenance costs fell $32 million, helped by vendor credits and lower wind-facility dismantlement costs.
The company sold interconnection assets and rights, recognizing a $33 million gain in the third quarter.
